name: mnemark-retrieval-quality-v1
description: Synthetic, deterministic coverage for lexical, fuzzy, multilingual, trust-aware, scoped, and relationship-aware recall.

memories.name: release_approval_policy
memories.content: Trigger: publishing a production release. Action: require explicit approval after checks pass. Why: release publication is an external side effect.

memories.name: release_checksum_procedure
memories.content: Trigger: preparing release artifacts. Action: verify archive and installer SHA-256 checksums before publication. Why: checksum verification catches changed release bytes.

memories.name: release_notes_style
memories.content: Trigger: drafting release notes. Action: use short headings and user-facing language. Why: readers scan release notes quickly.

memories.name: cjk_deployment_gate
memories.content: Trigger: 執行正式部署前。Action: 驗證備份、checksum 與回滾流程。Why: 部署前檢查可降低中斷風險。

memories.name: dependency_upgrade_runbook
memories.content: Trigger: reviewing a dependency upgrade. Action: run compatibility tests and inspect breaking changes. Why: dependency updates can change runtime behavior.

memories.name: incident_rollback_guide
memories.content: Trigger: a deployment health check fails. Action: stop rollout and restore the verified backup. Why: rollback limits incident impact.

memories.name: global_orion_handoff
memories.content: Trigger: the Orion handoff starts. Action: review the shared checklist. Why: the global process is a fallback.

memories.name: project_orion_handoff
memories.content: Trigger: the Orion handoff starts. Action: use the project approval checklist. Why: this project has a confirmed handoff policy.

memories.name: concise_reply_preference
memories.content: Trigger: writing a user-facing reply. Action: answer concisely. Why: the user explicitly requested concise responses.

semantic_edges.evidence: The release approval policy applies after release checks, including the checksum procedure.
